en.s: The Battle of Dun Nechtain or Battle of Nechtansmere (Scottish Gaelic: Blàr Dhùn Neachdain, Old Irish: Dún Nechtain, Old Welsh: Linn Garan, Old English: Nechtansmere) was fought between the Picts, led by King Bridei Mac Bili, and the Northumbrians, led by King Ecgfrith on 20 May 685. The Northumbrian hegemony over Northern Britain, won by Ecgfrith's predecessors, had begun to disintegrate. Several of Northumbria's subject nations had rebelled in recent years, leading to a number of large-scale battles against the Picts, Mercians, and Irish, with varied success.

zh.s: 邓内赫坦战役又称内克坦斯米尔战役，发生于685年5月20日，交战双方是布莱迪·麦克·比利国王率领的皮克特人和埃克格弗里斯国王率领的诺森布里亚人。埃克格弗里斯的前任曾建立对不列颠北部的霸权，但此时霸权开始瓦解。近年诺森布里亚的多个附属民族相继反叛，皮克特人、麦西亚人和爱尔兰人也多次与诺森布里亚交战，胜负不一。

en.t: Christopher Lekapenos is crowned Byzantine co-emperor by his father, emperor Romanos I Lekapenos, on the feast of Whitsun
en.s: Christopher Lekapenos or Lecapenus (Greek: Χριστόφορος Λακαπηνός or Λεκαπηνός, romanized: Christóphoros Lakapēnos or Lekapēnos; died August 931) was the eldest son of Emperor Romanos I Lekapenos (r. 920–944) and co-emperor of the Byzantine Empire from 921 until his death in 931. Christopher was given the position of megas hetaireiarches (commander of the palace guard) in spring 919, after Romanos assumed guardianship of the underage Emperor Constantine VII.

zh.t: 克里斯托弗·莱卡佩诺斯加冕为拜占庭共治皇帝
zh.s: 克里斯托弗·莱卡佩诺斯（希腊语：Χριστόφορος Λακαπηνός或Λεκαπηνός，转写为Christóphoros Lakapēnos或Lekapēnos；卒于931年8月）是皇帝罗曼努斯一世·莱卡佩诺斯（920—944年在位）的长子，921年至931年担任拜占庭共治皇帝。919年春，罗曼努斯接任未成年皇帝君士坦丁七世的监护人后，克里斯托弗获任宫廷卫队统领。

en.t: A Magyar raiding army defeats forces of the Muslim frontier state of Fraxinetum
en.s: A Hungarian raid in Spain took place in July 942. This was the furthest west the Hungarians raided during the period of their migration into central Europe; although, in a great raid of 924–25, the Hungarians sacked Nîmes and may have got as far as the Pyrenees. The only contemporary reference to the Hungarians crossing the Pyrenees into Spain is in al-Maʿsūdī, who wrote that "their raids extend to the lands of Rome and almost as far as Spain".

zh.t: 马扎尔劫掠军击败穆斯林边境政权法拉克西内图姆的军队
zh.s: 马扎尔人于942年7月袭击西班牙。这是他们迁徙至中欧期间向西最远的一次劫掠；不过，924—925年的一次大规模袭击中，马扎尔人洗劫了尼姆，可能还抵达比利牛斯山脉。关于马扎尔人越过比利牛斯山进入西班牙，当时唯一记载出自马苏第，他写道：“他们的劫掠范围延伸至罗马人的土地，几乎远至西班牙。”

en.s: The 1202 Syria earthquake struck at about dawn on 20 May 1202 (598 AH) with an epicenter in southwestern Syria. The earthquake is estimated to have killed around 30,000 people. It was felt over an extensive area, from Sicily to Mesopotamia and Anatolia to upper Egypt, mostly affecting the Ayyubid Sultanate and the Kingdom of Jerusalem. The cities of Tyre, Acre and Nablus were heavily damaged.

zh.s: 1202年5月20日黎明前后，叙利亚西南部发生地震，震级估计为7.6级（伊斯兰历598年）。地震估计造成约3万人死亡。震感范围很广，从西西里岛到美索不达米亚、从安纳托利亚到上埃及均有感受；主要受灾地区属于阿尤布王朝和耶路撒冷王国。泰尔、阿卡和纳布卢斯等城市遭到严重破坏。

en.s: The Second Battle of Lincoln occurred at Lincoln Castle on Saturday 20 May 1217, during the First Barons' War, between the forces of the future Louis VIII of France and those of King Henry III of England. Louis's forces were attacked by a relief force under the command of William Marshal, 1st Earl of Pembroke.

zh.s: 第二次林肯战役于1217年5月20日星期六在林肯城堡发生，是第一次男爵战争的一部分。交战双方分别是未来的法国国王路易八世的军队和英格兰国王亨利三世的军队。威廉·马歇尔（彭布罗克伯爵一世）率领的援军袭击了路易的部队。

en.t: King Sancho IV of Castile creates the Estudio de Escuelas de Generales in Alcalá de Henares
en.s: The Complutense University of Madrid (Spanish: Universidad Complutense de Madrid, UCM; Latin: Universitas Complutensis Matritensis) is a public research university located in Madrid. Founded in Alcalá in 1293 (before relocating to Madrid in 1836), it is one of the oldest operating universities in the world. It is located on a sprawling campus that occupies the entirety of the Ciudad Universitaria district of Madrid, with annexes in the district of Somosaguas in the neighboring city of Pozuelo de Alarcón.

zh.t: 卡斯蒂利亚国王桑乔四世在阿尔卡拉创办Estudio de Escuelas de Generales
zh.s: 马德里康普顿斯大学（西班牙语：Universidad Complutense de Madrid，UCM；拉丁语：Universitas Complutensis Matritensis）是位于马德里的公立研究型大学。该校1293年创办于阿尔卡拉，1836年迁至马德里，是世界上历史最悠久的大学之一。校园规模很大，覆盖马德里大学城城区，并在邻近城市波苏埃洛-德阿拉尔孔的索莫萨瓜斯区设有校区。

en.t: King Mohnyin Thado formally ascends to the throne of Ava
en.s: Mohnyin Thado (Burmese: မိုးညှင်း သတိုး, pronounced [móɲ̥ɪ́ɴ ðədó]; Shan: မိူင်းယၢင်းထၢတ်ႈဢူး, Mongyang That Oo; 1379–1439) was king of Ava from 1426 to 1439. He is also known in Burmese history as Mohnyin Min Taya (မိုးညှင်း မင်းတရား, [móɲ̥ɪ́ɴ mɪ́ɴ təjá], "Righteous Lord of Mohnyin") after his longtime tenure as the sawbwa of Mohnyin, a Shan-speaking frontier state (in present-day Kachin State, Myanmar).

zh.t: 莫欣国王达多正式登基为阿瓦国王
zh.s: 莫欣达多（缅甸语：မိုးညှင်း သတိုး，读音：[móɲ̥ɪ́ɴ ðədó]；掸语：မိူင်းယၢင်းထၢတ်ႈဢူး，Mongyang That Oo；1379—1439年）于1426年至1439年担任阿瓦国王。他在缅甸史料中也称莫欣明塔亚（မိုးညှင်း မင်းတရား，意为“莫欣的正义之主”），这是他长期担任莫欣诏法（掸语区边境邦，今缅甸克钦邦）后获得的称呼。

en.s: The Battle of Alfarrobeira (Portuguese pronunciation: [aɫfɐʁuˈbɐjɾɐ]) took place on 20 May 1449. It was a confrontation between the forces commanded by King Afonso V of Portugal and his uncle Afonso, Duke of Braganza, against the army of the rebellious Peter, Duke of Coimbra. The place was Alverca do Ribatejo, near Lisbon, at the margins of the creek of Alfarrobeira. The result was the clear defeat and death of the Duke of Coimbra and the establishment of the Braganzas as the most powerful House of Portugal.

zh.s: 阿尔法罗贝拉战役发生于1449年5月20日。葡萄牙国王阿方索五世及其叔父布拉干萨公爵阿方索率军，对抗科英布拉公爵佩德罗领导的叛军。战场位于里斯本附近的阿尔韦卡-杜里巴特茹，在阿尔法罗贝拉溪畔。科英布拉公爵战败身亡，布拉干萨家族由此成为葡萄牙势力最强的家族。

en.t: Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama discovers the sea route to India when he arrives at Kozhikode (previously known as Calicut), India
en.s: Vasco da Gama ( VAS-koo də GA(H)M-ə, European Portuguese: [ˈvaʃku ðɐ ˈɣɐmɐ]; c. 1460s – 24 December 1524) was a Portuguese mariner, explorer and nobleman. His discovery of the first maritime route between Europe and India—around the Cape of Good Hope, then across the Indian Ocean from Malindi in Kenya to Kozhikode—opened up European exploration of, and commerce with, India, and is considered a landmark event in world history.

zh.t: 达·伽马抵达印度科泽科德，发现通往印度的海路
zh.s: 瓦斯科·达·伽马（葡萄牙语发音：[ˈvaʃku ðɐ ˈɣɐmɐ]；约1460年代—1524年12月24日）是葡萄牙航海家、探险家和贵族。他开辟了欧洲与印度之间的第一条海上航线：绕过好望角，再从肯尼亚的马林迪横渡印度洋抵达科泽科德。这条航线开启了欧洲对印度的探索和贸易，是世界历史上的重要事件。

en.s: The Battle of Pampluna or Battle of Pamplona was a battle fought during the Italian War of 1521–1526 on 20 May 1521 during which forces led by the Kingdom of Navarre with support from France conquered the Fortress of Pamplona from Spain. The battle coincided with an uprising by a part of the Navarrese population and the swift reconquest of all of Navarre from the Spanish.

zh.s: 潘普洛纳战役发生于1521年5月20日，是1521—1526年意大利战争期间的一场战斗。纳瓦拉王国军队在法国支持下攻占西班牙控制的潘普洛纳要塞。战斗期间，部分纳瓦拉民众起义，纳瓦拉随后迅速从西班牙统治下被收复。

en.s: The 1562 Battle of Kyōkōji (教興寺の戦い, no Tatakai) was one of many battles fought between the Miyoshi and Hatakeyama in Japan's Sengoku period. On 19–20 May of that year, the battle was won by Miyoshi Nagayoshi over Hatakeyama Takamasa.

en.t: Shakespeare's sonnets are first published in London, perhaps illicitly, by the publisher Thomas Thorpe
en.s: William Shakespeare (c. 23 April 1564 – 23 April 1616) wrote sonnets on a variety of themes. When discussing or referring to Shakespeare's sonnets, it is almost always a reference to the 154 sonnets that were first published all together in a quarto in 1609. However, there are six additional sonnets that Shakespeare wrote and included in the plays Romeo and Juliet, Henry V and Love's Labour's Lost.

zh.t: 莎士比亚十四行诗集或于伦敦首次出版，出版商托马斯·索普可能未获授权
zh.s: 威廉·莎士比亚（约1564年4月23日—1616年4月23日）创作了多种主题的十四行诗。人们通常所说的莎士比亚十四行诗，是指1609年首次汇集出版的一组154首诗，以四开本印行。他还创作了另外6首十四行诗，收录在《罗密欧与朱丽叶》《亨利五世》和《爱的徒劳》等戏剧中。

en.s: The Sack of Magdeburg, also called the Magdeburg Wedding (German: Magdeburger Hochzeit) or Magdeburg's Sacrifice (Magdeburgs Opfergang), was the destruction of the Protestant city of Magdeburg on 20–24 May 1631 by the Imperial Army and the forces of the Catholic League, resulting in the deaths of around 20,000, including both defenders and civilians. This event is considered the worst massacre of the Thirty Years' War.

zh.s: 马格德堡劫掠又称“马格德堡婚礼”或“马格德堡殉难”，是帝国军和天主教联盟军于1631年5月20日至24日摧毁新教城市马格德堡的事件。约2万名守军和平民在事件中丧生。这被认为是三十年战争期间最惨重的大屠杀。

en.s: The Battle of Les Avins or Battle of Avein was fought on 20 May 1635 during the Thirty Years' War between a French and a Spanish army. The battle was fought in the Belgian village of Les Avins, south of Huy, in what was then the bishopric of Liège. It was the first serious engagement for the French, which had entered the war only three months before. The French army was under command of Marshals of France Urbain de Maillé-Brézé and Gaspard III de Coligny, Maréchal de Châtillon.The Spanish were commanded by Thomas Francis, Prince of Carignano.

zh.s: 莱阿万战役又称阿韦因战役，发生于1635年5月20日，是三十年战争期间法国军队与西班牙军队之间的一场战斗。战场位于当时列日主教辖区内、于伊以南的比利时村庄莱阿万。这是法国参战三个月来首次大规模交战。法军由法国元帅于尔班·德·马耶-布雷泽和加斯帕尔三世·德·科利尼（沙蒂永元帅）指挥；西班牙军队由卡里尼亚诺亲王托马斯·弗朗西斯指挥。

en.s: The Yangzhou massacre took place in 1645 in Yangzhou, China, during the Qing dynasty. Mass killings of residents in Yangzhou were conducted by Qing troops under the command of Prince Dodo after they conquered the city from forces loyal to the Southern Ming regime of the Hongguang Emperor. The massacre lasted ten days after the city fell on May 20, 1645. Traditionally, the number of victims was reported as close to 800,000, although some modern scholars consider it an exaggeration. The defending commander, Shi Kefa, was also executed by Qing forces after he refused to submit to their authority.

zh.s: 扬州大屠杀发生于1645年清朝时期的中国扬州。清军在多铎亲王率领下攻占扬州，随后大规模杀害城中居民。清军于1645年5月20日攻陷扬州后，屠杀持续了10天。传统说法称遇难人数接近80万，但一些现代学者认为这一数字被夸大。守城将领史可法拒绝投降，也被清军处死。

en.s: The Battle of Nevis on 20 May 1667 was a confused naval clash in the Caribbean off the island of Nevis during the closing stages of the Second Anglo-Dutch War. It was fought between an English squadron and an Allied Franco-Dutch fleet intent on invading the island. The battle ended up being an English victory in that it prevented a Franco-Dutch invasion of Nevis.

zh.s: 尼维斯海战发生于1667年5月20日，是第二次英荷战争末期加勒比海尼维斯岛附近一场混乱的海战。交战双方是英国分舰队和试图入侵该岛的法荷联军舰队。英国军队阻止了入侵，因此这场战斗以英国获胜告终。

en.s: Johann Sebastian Bach (31 March [O.S. 21 March] 1685 – 28 July 1750) was a German composer and musician of the late Baroque period. He is known for his prolific output across a variety of instruments and forms, including the orchestral Brandenburg Concertos; solo instrumental works such as the Cello Suites and Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin; keyboard works such as the Goldberg Variations and The Well-Tempered Clavier; organ works such as the Schübler Chorales and the Toccata and Fugue in D minor; and choral works such as the St.

zh.t: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫在魏玛宫廷教堂首演五旬节康塔塔《歌声响起》，BWV 172
zh.s: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫（1685年3月31日〔儒略历3月21日〕—1750年7月28日）是巴洛克晚期的德国作曲家和音乐家。他创作丰富，作品涵盖多种乐器和体裁，包括管弦乐《勃兰登堡协奏曲》、大提琴组曲和无伴奏小提琴奏鸣曲与组曲等独奏作品、《哥德堡变奏曲》和《平均律键盘曲集》等键盘作品、管风琴作品以及合唱作品。

en.s: The Battle of Cartagena de Indias (Spanish: Sitio de Cartagena de Indias, lit. 'Siege of Cartagena de Indias') took place during the 1739 to 1748 War of Jenkins' Ear between Spain and Great Britain. The result of long-standing commercial tensions, the war was primarily fought in the Caribbean; the British tried to capture key Spanish ports in the region, including Porto Bello and Chagres in Panama, Havana, and Cartagena de Indias in present-day Colombia.
en.n: The Battle of Cartagena de Indias ends in a Spanish victory and the British begin withdrawal towards Jamaica with substantial losses.

zh.t: 卡塔赫纳-德印第亚斯战役
zh.s: 卡塔赫纳-德印第亚斯战役发生于1739至1748年詹金斯耳朵战争期间，交战双方是西班牙和英国。战争源于长期的商业矛盾，主要在加勒比海地区进行。英国试图夺取当地重要的西班牙港口，包括巴拿马的波托韦洛和查格雷斯、哈瓦那，以及今哥伦比亚境内的卡塔赫纳-德印第亚斯。
zh.n: 卡塔赫纳-德印第亚斯战役以西班牙获胜告终，英军随后损失惨重，开始撤往牙买加。

en.s: The Battle at Korpoström was a naval engagement that took place during the Russo-Swedish war of 1741–1743. The battle occurred on May 20, 1743, near Korpoström, Finland, and resulted in a decisive Russian victory. The Swedish fleet, commanded by Abraham Falkengréen, consisted of 31 ships, primarily composed of lightly armed galleys. The Russian forces, led by James Keith, fielded 21 ships, also mainly consisting of lightly armed galleys.

zh.s: 科尔波斯特伦海战是1741—1743年俄瑞战争期间的一场海战，于1743年5月20日在芬兰科尔波斯特伦附近发生，俄军取得决定性胜利。亚伯拉罕·法尔肯格伦指挥的瑞典舰队有31艘船，主要是装备轻型武器的桨帆船。詹姆斯·基思率领的俄军有21艘船，也以轻型武器桨帆船为主。

en.s: The Capture of Vigilant was an incident in May 1745 of the naval warfare of King George's War. British forces captured the French vessel Vigilant off Nova Scotia. It involved Commodore Warren in HMS Superb (60 guns), Captain Durell in HMS Eltham (40 guns), Captain Calmady in HMS Launceston, Captain Douglas in HMS Mermaid and Captain John Rous of HMS Shirley Galley who fought the French ship Vigilant (64 guns) off Louisbourg.

zh.s: “警觉号”被俘事件发生于1745年5月，是乔治王之战期间的一场海战。英军在新斯科舍外海俘获法国舰船“警觉号”。英军参战舰只包括沃伦准将指挥的“超凡号”（60门炮）、杜雷尔上校指挥的“埃尔瑟姆号”（40门炮）、卡尔马迪上校指挥的“劳恩斯顿号”、道格拉斯上校指挥的“美人鱼号”，以及约翰·鲁斯上校指挥的“雪莉号”桨帆船；他们在路易斯堡外海与载有64门炮的法国“警觉号”交战。

en.s: The Battle of Minorca was a fleet action fought on 20 May 1756 between the French and British navies during the Seven Years' War. Fought off Minorca shortly after the war began, it was the opening naval battle of the war's European theatre and resulted in a French strategic victory. The decision by the British fleet's commander, Admiral of the Blue John Byng, to withdraw to Gibraltar led directly to the fall of Minorca.

zh.s: 梅诺卡海战于1756年5月20日爆发，是七年战争期间法国和英国海军在梅诺卡岛外海进行的一场舰队交战。这是战争开始后欧洲战区的首场海战，法国取得战略胜利。英国舰队蓝中将约翰·宾决定撤往直布罗陀，直接导致梅诺卡岛失守。

en.s: The action of (the) Tyniec Abbey was an engagement between the armies of the Russian Empire and the Bar Confederation that took place on 20 May 1771. Russian Major-General Suvorov, in co-operation with Lieutenant-Colonel Shepelev's cavalry, assaulted Lieutenant-Colonel Dumouriez's army on a mountain redoubt fortified with a palisade, trous de loup, and two cannons; near the Tyniec Abbey, the village of Tyniec; but after taking the redoubt twice, they were twice repulsed, however, managed to capture all the cannons; Suvorov refused to retake the redoubt, and withdrew to meet Dumouriez, who had meanwhile brought reinforcements, in the third confrontation at Lanckorona.

zh.s: 蒂涅茨修道院战斗于1771年5月20日爆发，交战双方是俄罗斯帝国军队和巴尔联盟军。俄军少将苏沃洛夫与舍佩列夫中校的骑兵协同，对抗杜穆里埃中校率领、驻扎在山地堡垒中的军队。堡垒设有木栅栏、拒马坑和两门大炮，位于蒂涅茨村附近的蒂涅茨修道院一带。俄军两次攻下堡垒，又两次被击退，但缴获了全部大炮。苏沃洛夫拒绝再次进攻，撤去与杜穆里埃会合；杜穆里埃当时已带来援军，双方随后在兰茨科罗纳发生第三次交战。

en.s: The Mecklenburg Declaration of Independence is claimed by some to be the first declaration of independence made in the Thirteen Colonies during the American Revolution. It was supposedly signed on May 20, 1775, at Charlotte, North Carolina, by a committee of citizens of Mecklenburg County, who declared independence from Great Britain after hearing of the battle of Lexington. If the story is true, the Mecklenburg Declaration preceded the United States Declaration of Independence by more than a year. The authenticity of the Mecklenburg Declaration has been disputed since it was first published in 1819, forty-four years after it was reputedly written.

zh.s: 有人认为，梅克伦堡独立宣言是美国独立战争期间十三殖民地发表的第一份独立宣言。据称，1775年5月20日，北卡罗来纳州夏洛特的梅克伦堡县居民委员会在听闻列克星敦战役后签署宣言，宣布脱离英国独立。如果这一说法属实，这份宣言比《美国独立宣言》早一年多。自1819年首次发表以来，这份宣言的真实性一直受到质疑；据称它写于1775年，但发表时已相隔44年。

en.s: The Battle of Barren Hill was a minor engagement during the American Revolution. On May 20, 1778, a British force attempted to encircle a smaller Continental force under the Marquis de Lafayette. The maneuver failed, with the Continentals escaping the trap, but the British took the field.

zh.s: 巴伦山战役是美国独立战争期间的一场小规模交战。1778年5月20日，英军试图包围拉法耶特侯爵率领的一支人数较少的大陆军。英军的行动失败，大陆军成功脱困，但战场最终由英军控制。

en.s: The Siege of Mangalore was conducted during the Second Anglo-Mysore War by Tipu Sultan and forces of the Kingdom of Mysore against a British East India Company garrison led by Colonel Campbell. The port city of Mangalore on the west coast of India was besieged from 20 May 1783 until the garrison capitulated on 30 January 1784 after being reduced to starvation; of the original garrison of 700 British soldiers and 2000 Indian troops there were only 850 survivors. The siege was one of the last major actions of the war; Mangalore was where the treaty ending the war was signed in March 1784.

zh.s: 第二次英迈战争期间，蒂普苏丹及迈索尔王国军队围攻由坎贝尔上校率领的英国东印度公司驻军。印度西海岸港口城市芒格洛尔从1783年5月20日起遭到围困。驻军因饥饿于1784年1月30日投降；原有700名英国士兵和2000名印度士兵，最后仅850人幸存。这是战争最后几场主要战斗之一。结束战争的条约于1784年3月在芒格洛尔签署。

en.s: The British expedition to Ostend took place on 18 May 1798 during the French Revolutionary Wars. The expedition was intended to destroy the gun-boats harboured in Ostend, since they were destined to take part in the planned invasion of Britain. It also hoped to destroy the infrastructure of the port including the locks, basin-gates, and sluices of the Bruges–Ostend Canal.

en.s: The Battle of Tamatave (sometimes called the Battle of Madagascar or the Action of 20 May 1811) was fought off Tamatave in Madagascar between British and French frigate squadrons during the Napoleonic Wars. The action was the final engagement of the Mauritius campaign of 1809–1811, and it saw the destruction of the last French attempt to reinforce their garrison on Mauritius. Although the news had not reached Europe by February 1811 when the reinforcement squadron left Brest, Mauritius had been captured in December 1810 by a British invasion fleet, the French defences hampered by the lack of the supplies and troops carried aboard the frigate squadron under the command of Commodore François Roquebert in Renommée.

zh.s: 塔马塔夫海战又称马达加斯加海战或1811年5月20日海战，是拿破仑战争期间英国和法国护卫舰分舰队在马达加斯加塔马塔夫外海交战。此战是1809—1811年毛里求斯战役的最后一场交战，也粉碎了法国向毛里求斯守军增派援军的最后一次尝试。1810年12月英国入侵舰队已攻占毛里求斯，但1811年2月援军分舰队从布雷斯特出发时，欧洲尚未收到这一消息。法国护卫舰“荣誉号”搭载了这支分舰队的指挥官弗朗索瓦·罗克贝尔准将及补给和兵员；当时法军防御因缺少这些物资而受影响。

en.s: In the Battle of Bautzen (20–21 May 1813), a combined Prusso-Russian army, retreating after their defeat at Lützen and massively outnumbered, was pushed back by Napoleon but escaped destruction. Some sources claim that Marshal Michel Ney failed to block their retreat. The Prussians were led by General Gebhard Leberecht von Blücher, and the Russians by General Peter Wittgenstein.

zh.s: 包岑战役于1813年5月20日至21日进行。普鲁士和俄罗斯联军在吕岑战败后撤退，人数远少于法军，随后被拿破仑击退，但没有被歼灭。一些来源称，米歇尔·内伊元帅未能阻止联军撤退。普军由格布哈德·列贝雷希特·冯·布吕歇尔将军率领，俄军由彼得·维特根施泰因将军率领。

en.s: The Neapolitan War, also known as the Austro-Neapolitan War, was a conflict between the Napoleonic Kingdom of Naples and the Austrian Empire. It started on 15 March 1815, when King Joachim Murat declared war on Austria, and ended on 20 May 1815, with the signing of the Treaty of Casalanza. The war occurred during the Hundred Days between Napoleon's return from exile and before he left Paris to be decisively defeated at the Battle of Waterloo.

zh.s: 那不勒斯战争又称奥那战争，是拿破仑统治下的那不勒斯王国与奥地利帝国之间的冲突。1815年3月15日，约阿希姆·缪拉国王向奥地利宣战，战争由此开始；5月20日，双方签署卡萨兰扎条约，战争结束。战争发生在“百日王朝”期间，即拿破仑结束流放返回、离开巴黎前往滑铁卢并在那里遭到决定性击败的那段时期。

en.s: The Battle of Maniaki was fought on May 20, 1825 in Maniaki, Greece (in the hills east of Gargalianoi) between Egyptian forces led by Ibrahim Pasha and Greek forces led by Papaflessas.

en.s: The Battle of Atly-Boyun was fought on 20 May 1831 during the Caucasian War between Russian forces and a coalition of Dagestani rebels from the North Caucasian Imamate and the Tarki Shamkhalate. It ended in a significant victory for the rebels and marked an important moment in the early military career of Imam Ghazi Muhammad.

zh.s: 阿特雷博云战役于1831年5月20日爆发，是高加索战争期间俄军与达吉斯坦叛军联盟之间的一场战斗。叛军联盟由北高加索伊玛目国和塔尔基沙姆哈拉特的力量组成。战役以叛军大胜告终，也是伊玛目加齐·穆罕默德早期军事生涯中的重要时刻。

en.s: The First Battle of Taku Forts was the first invasion of the Anglo-French alliance against the Taku Forts along the Hai River in Tianjin, China, on 20 May 1858, during the Second Opium War. The British and French sent a squadron of gunboats, under Rear-Admiral Admiral Michael Seymour, to attack China's Taku Forts. The battle ended as an allied success. However, the first phase of the Second Opium War would end with the Treaties of Tianjin and the forts were returned to the hands of the Qing Army, leading to the Second Battle of Taku Forts in 1859.

zh.t: 第一次大沽炮台之战（1858年）
zh.s: 1858年5月20日，英法联军在第二次鸦片战争期间首次进攻中国天津海河沿岸的大沽炮台。英法派出一支由海军少将迈克尔·西摩指挥的炮艇分舰队进攻炮台，联军获胜。不过，第二次鸦片战争第一阶段最终以《天津条约》签订告终，炮台也归还清军，随后双方于1859年再次交战。

en.s: The Battle of Montebello was fought on 20 May 1859 at Montebello (in what is now Lombardy, northern Italy). It was a minor engagement of the Second Italian War of Independence, fought between Piedmontese cavalry and French infantry against Austrian troops.Because of this battle, the Austrian commander in chief was obliged to keep some troops to cover the southern part of the front.

zh.s: 蒙特贝洛战役于1859年5月20日在蒙特贝洛交战，战场位于今意大利北部伦巴第。它是第二次意大利独立战争中的一场小规模交战，皮埃蒙特骑兵和法国步兵联手对抗奥地利军队。战后，奥地利总司令不得不留下部分兵力防守战线南段。

en.t: After the Southern states seceded from the Union in 1861 (and their representatives had left Congress), the bill passed and was signed into law by President Abraham Lincoln (May 20, 1862)
en.s: The Homestead Acts were several laws in the United States by which an applicant could acquire ownership of government land or the public domain, typically called a homestead. In all, more than 160 million acres (650 thousand km2; 250 thousand sq mi) of public land, or nearly 10 percent of the total area of the United States, were given away free to 1.6 million homesteaders; most of the homesteads were west of the Mississippi River.

zh.t: 南方各州脱离联邦后，《宅地法》在国会通过并由林肯总统签署（1862年5月20日）
zh.s: 美国先后通过多项《宅地法》，允许申请者取得政府土地或公共土地的所有权，这类土地通常称为宅地。根据这些法律，超过1.6亿英亩（65万平方公里；25万平方英里）的公共土地被免费分配给160万名宅地申请者，接近美国总面积的10%；大多数宅地位于密西西比河以西。

en.s: The La Paz incident occurred on May 20, 1863, at the mining town of La Paz, Arizona. William "Frog" Edwards, only recently released from detention at Fort Yuma, ambushed a party of Union soldiers when they stopped at La Paz to purchase supplies. Edwards' attack killed one soldier and wounded two more. Edwards then fled into the desert where he died of exposure and dehydration.

zh.s: 拉巴斯事件于1863年5月20日发生在亚利桑那州矿业城镇拉巴斯。威廉·“青蛙”·爱德华兹刚从尤马堡拘留所获释不久，趁一队联邦士兵在拉巴斯停下购买补给时发动伏击。袭击造成1名士兵死亡、2人受伤。爱德华兹随后逃入沙漠，最终因暴露和脱水而死。

en.s: The Battle of Ware Bottom Church was fought on May 20, 1864, between Union and Confederate forces during the American Civil War. The Union troops were led by Benjamin Butler, while the Confederates were led by P.G.T. Beauregard. The Confederates were victorious, and Butler's forces remained in their Bermuda Hundred defenses. Following the battle, the Confederates began digging a critical set of defensive earthworks that became known as the Howlett Line.

zh.s: 韦尔伯顿教堂战役于1864年5月20日爆发，是美国内战期间联邦军与邦联军之间的一场交战。联邦军由本杰明·巴特勒率领，邦联军由P·G·T·博雷加德指挥。邦联军获胜，巴特勒的部队仍留在百慕大百区防线内。战后，邦联军开始修筑一组重要防御土垒，后来称为豪利特防线。

en.s: The Assault of Paso Cidra was an allied military operation during the Paraguayan War, which took place on May 20, 1866, in Estero Bellaco, Paraguay. The action consisted of the assault by Brazilian forces of the 2nd Infantry Battalion, under the command of Vanderlei Lins, subordinate of Uruguayan general Venâncio Flores, to a Paraguayan entrenched position, defended by men of Lieutenant Colonel Avelino Cabral.

zh.s: 帕索西德拉突击战是巴拉圭战争期间盟军的一次军事行动，于1866年5月20日在巴拉圭埃斯特罗贝亚科发生。巴西军队在范德莱·林斯指挥下，突袭由乌拉圭将军韦南西奥·弗洛雷斯统辖、阿韦利诺·卡布拉尔中校率领的巴拉圭军队坚固阵地。

en.s: The Battle of Irjar was a battle between the Russian Empire and the Emirate of Bukhara on May 20, 1866, near Irjar, a narrow pass on the left bank of the Syr Darya river, between Chinoz and Khujand. It was fought between a Russian contingent commanded by Major Romanovsky against the Bukharans of Muzaffar bin Nasrullah.

zh.s: 伊尔贾尔战役于1866年5月20日在伊尔贾尔附近爆发，交战双方是俄罗斯帝国和布哈拉酋长国。伊尔贾尔是锡尔河左岸、奇诺兹和苦盏之间的一处狭窄通道。俄军分遣队由罗曼诺夫斯基少校指挥，布哈拉军队由穆扎法尔·本·纳斯鲁拉率领。

en.s: Levi Strauss ( LEE-vy STROWSS; born Löb Strauß, German: [løːp ˈʃtʁaʊs]; February 26, 1829 – September 26, 1902) was a German-born American businessman who founded the first company to manufacture blue jeans. His firm of Levi Strauss & Co. (Levi's) began in 1853 in San Francisco, California.

zh.t: 李维·施特劳斯与雅各布·戴维斯获美国蓝色牛仔裤铜铆钉专利
zh.s: 李维·施特劳斯（读作LEE-vy STROWSS；出生名勒布·施特劳斯，德语： [løːp ˈʃtʁaʊs]；1829年2月26日—1902年9月26日）是出生于德国的美国商人，创办了首家生产蓝色牛仔裤的公司。他的公司李维·施特劳斯公司（Levi's）于1853年在加利福尼亚州旧金山成立。

en.s: Metre Convention (French: Convention du Mètre), also known as the Treaty of the Metre, is an international treaty that was signed in Paris on 20 May 1875 by representatives of 17 nations. The treaty set up an institute for the purpose of coordinating international metrology and for coordinating the development of the metric system. The treaty also set up associated organizations to oversee the running of the institute.

en.s: The Kumanovo uprising was an uprising organized by an assembly of chiefs of the districts (Ottoman kaza) of Kumanovo, Kriva Palanka, and Kratovo in the Vilayet of Kosovo (in modern-day North Macedonia) in 1878. The movement sought to liberate the region from the hands of the Ottoman Empire. Following the Serbian Army's liberation of Niš on 12 January 1877, the rebellion began on 20 January 1878 with guerrilla operations during the army's liberation of Vranje.

zh.s: 奇拉安宫事件又称阿里·苏阿维事件（土耳其奥斯曼语：واقعه چراغان；转写：Vak'â-yı Çırağan），是1878年5月20日发生的一场未遂政变。阿里·苏阿维率领一群异见人士，试图推翻奥斯曼苏丹阿卜杜勒-哈米德二世，改立其兄弟穆拉德五世。穆拉德当时被软禁在奇拉安宫。

en.t: The Triple Alliance between the German Empire, Austria-Hungary and the Kingdom of Italy is formed
en.s: The Triple Alliance was a defensive military alliance between Germany, Austria-Hungary, and Italy. It was formed on 20 May 1882 and renewed periodically until it expired in 1915 during World War I. Germany and Austria-Hungary had been closely allied since 1879. Italy was looking for support against France shortly after it lost North African ambitions to the French.

zh.t: 德国、奥匈帝国和意大利组成三国同盟
zh.s: 三国同盟是德国、奥匈帝国和意大利组成的防御性军事同盟，于1882年5月20日成立。此后同盟定期续约，直至1915年第一次世界大战期间终止。德国和奥匈帝国自1879年起关系密切；意大利在对法国失去北非扩张机会后，希望获得支持。

en.s: Between 19 May and 21 October 1883, the volcanic island of Krakatoa (located in the Sunda Strait, then part of the Dutch East Indies—modern-day Indonesia) began erupting, lasting more than five months. On 27 August, the island had its most significant eruption, which destroyed over 70% of the island and its surrounding archipelago, the island collapsing into a caldera.

zh.s: 1883年5月19日至10月21日，位于巽他海峡的火山岛喀拉喀托开始喷发，当时该地属于荷属东印度（今印度尼西亚）。喷发持续了5个多月。8月27日火山发生最猛烈的喷发，摧毁了岛屿及周边群岛70%以上的面积，火山岛随后坍塌，形成火山口。

en.s: The Oamaru by-election 1885 was a by-election held in the Oamaru electorate during the 9th New Zealand Parliament, on 20 May 1885. The by-election was caused by the resignation of the incumbent, Samuel Shrimski, who was appointed to the Legislative Council, and was won by Thomas William Hislop.

en.t: With the end of U.S. military government jurisdiction, Cuba gained formal independence on 20 May 1902 as the Republic of Cuba
en.s: Cuba, officially the Republic of Cuba, is an island country in the Caribbean. It comprises the eponymous main island as well as 4,195 islands, islets, and cays. Situated at the convergence of the Caribbean Sea, Gulf of Mexico, and Atlantic Ocean, Cuba is located east of the Yucatán Peninsula, south of both Florida and the Bahamas, west of Hispaniola, and north of Jamaica and the Cayman Islands.

zh.t: 美国军事管辖结束，古巴于1902年5月20日正式独立并成立古巴共和国
zh.s: 古巴，正式名称为古巴共和国，是加勒比海岛国，由古巴主岛及4,195座岛屿、小岛和礁岛组成。古巴位于加勒比海、墨西哥湾和大西洋交汇处：在尤卡坦半岛以东、佛罗里达州和巴哈马以南、伊斯帕尼奥拉岛以西，以及牙买加和开曼群岛以北。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in France on 6 and 20 May 1906. The elections produced an increased majority for the governing coalition between the Radicals (PRRRS) and the left Republicans (ARD), which had held power under the premierships of Maurice Rouvier and Ferdinand Sarrien since January 1905. Sarrien resigned on 20 October for reasons of health.

zh.s: 法国于1906年5月6日和20日举行立法选举。激进党（PRRRS）与左翼共和党人（ARD）组成的执政联盟扩大了多数优势；自1905年1月以来，政府先后由莫里斯·鲁维埃和费迪南·萨里安领导。萨里安因健康原因于10月20日辞职。

en.s: The War of 1912 (Spanish: Levantamiento Armado de los Independientes de Color, lit. 'Armed Uprising of the Independents of Color'), also known as the Little Race War or The Twelve, was a series of protests and uprisings in 1912 in Cuba. The conflict was between Afro-Cuban rebels and the armed forces of Cuba, taking place mainly in the eastern region of the island where most Afro-Cubans lived and worked.

zh.s: 1912年战争（西班牙语：Levantamiento Armado de los Independientes de Color，意为“有色人种独立派武装起义”），又称“小种族战争”或“十二人事件”，是1912年古巴发生的一系列抗议和起义。冲突发生在非裔古巴反叛者与古巴武装部队之间，主要集中在岛屿东部，当地多数非裔古巴人生活和工作于此。

en.s: The 1914 North East Derbyshire by-election was a Parliamentary by-election held on 20 May 1914. The constituency returned one Member of Parliament (MP) to the House of Commons of the United Kingdom, elected by the first past the post voting system. About a third of the electorate were directly involved in the mining industry. This was the penultimate by-election to take place before the outbreak of the First World War.

zh.s: 东北德比郡于1914年5月20日举行议会补选，选出一名英国下议院议员，采用简单多数制。约三分之一选民直接从事采矿业。这是第一次世界大战爆发前倒数第二场补选。

en.s: The Battle of Pakoslaw took place in the night of May 19–20, 1915, near the village of Pakoslaw, Congress Poland. It was the first battle of the so-called Pulawy Legion, a Polish military formation of World War I, which was part of the Imperial Russian Army. Soldiers of the Legion clashed with the German Empire armed forces, during Russian retreat of 1915 (see also Great Retreat).
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 帕科斯瓦夫战役于1915年5月19日至20日夜间在波兰会议王国帕科斯瓦夫村附近发生。这是第一次世界大战期间所谓“普瓦维军团”参加的首场战斗。该波兰军事编制隶属俄罗斯帝国军队，其士兵在俄军1915年大撤退期间与德意志帝国军队交战。

en.s: The 1927 Treaty of Jeddah, formally the Treaty between His Majesty and His Majesty the King of the Hejaz and of Nejd and Its Dependencies was signed between the United Kingdom and Ibn Saud. It was signed by Sir Gilbert Clayton on behalf of the United Kingdom and Prince Faisal bin Abdulaziz on behalf of Kingdom of Hejaz and Nejd on 20 May 1927.

zh.s: 1927年《吉达条约》的正式名称为《英国国王与汉志、内志及其属地国王之间的条约》，由英国和伊本·沙特签署。1927年5月20日，吉尔伯特·克莱顿爵士代表英国签署，费萨尔·本·阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹王子代表汉志和内志王国签署。

en.s: Federal elections were held in Germany on 20 May 1928. The Social Democratic Party (SPD) remained the largest party in the Reichstag after winning 153 of the 491 seats. Voter turnout was 75.6%. The only two parties to gain significantly were the SPD, who polled almost a third of votes, and the Communist Party of Germany, completing a thorough victory of the left-wing. However, although the SPD now had 153 seats, they still failed to gain a clear majority, resulting in another coalition government led by Hermann Müller.

zh.s: 德国于1928年5月20日举行联邦选举。社会民主党赢得491席中的153席，继续成为国会第一大党，投票率为75.6%。只有社会民主党和德国共产党两党得票显著增加，左翼整体取得重大胜利。不过，社民党虽获得153席，仍未取得绝对多数，因此德国再次组成由赫尔曼·穆勒领导的联合政府。

Roosevelt was selected as the nominee through a series of primary elections and caucuses culminating in the 1932 Democratic National Convention held from June 27 to July 2, 1932, in Chicago, Illinois.

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Griffith on 20 May 1939. This was triggered by the death of Labor Party MP Frank Baker. The election was won by Labor candidate William Conelan by eight votes. Immediately after Baker's death, there was some speculation that Queensland premier, William Forgan Smith would contest the by-election.

zh.s: 澳大利亚众议院格里菲斯选区于1939年5月20日举行补选。工党议员弗兰克·贝克去世后，选区需要补选。工党候选人威廉·科纳兰以8票优势当选。贝克去世后不久，曾有人猜测昆士兰州州长威廉·福根·史密斯会参加补选。

en.s: The Battle of Crete (German: Luftlandeschlacht um Kreta, Greek: Μάχη της Κρήτης, also Unternehmen Merkur, Operation Mercury) was fought during World War II on the Greek island of Crete. It began on the morning of 20 May 1941, when Nazi Germany began an airborne invasion of Crete. Greek forces and other Allied forces, along with Cretan civilians, defended the island. After one day of fighting, the Germans had suffered heavy casualties and the Allied troops were confident that they would defeat the invasion.

zh.s: 克里特岛战役又称“水星行动”，是第二次世界大战期间德国在希腊克里特岛发动的空降入侵。1941年5月20日上午，纳粹德国开始入侵。希腊军队、其他盟军部队以及克里特岛平民共同守卫该岛。战斗进行一天后，德军伤亡惨重，盟军仍有信心击退入侵。

en.s: The Demyansk Pocket (German: Kessel von Demjansk; Russian: Демя́нский котёл) was the name given to the pocket of German troops encircled by the Red Army around Demyansk, south of Leningrad, on World War II's Eastern Front. The pocket existed mainly from 8 February to 21 April 1942. A much smaller force was surrounded in the Kholm Pocket at the town of Kholm, about 100 km (62 mi) to the southwest.

zh.s: 杰米扬斯克包围圈（德语：Kessel von Demjansk；俄语：Демя́нский котёл）是第二次世界大战东线中，红军在列宁格勒以南杰米扬斯克附近包围的一支德军部队。包围圈主要存在于1942年2月8日至4月21日。另有规模小得多的一支德军在霍尔姆镇被围，那里位于西南约100公里（62英里）。

SC 130 was one of several convoy battles that occurred during the crisis month of May 1943.

en.t: The Luttra Woman (skull pictured), a bog body from the Early Neolithic period, was discovered near Luttra, Sweden
en.s: The Luttra Woman is a skeletonised bog body discovered in a peat bog in Falbygden near Luttra, Sweden. The remains were found on 20 May 1943 by a peat cutter. The skull was well-preserved, but some bones of the skeleton, particularly many between the skull and the pelvis, were missing. Osteological assessment identified the remains as those of a young female.

zh.s: 卢特拉女子是一具在瑞典卢特拉附近法尔比格登泥炭沼泽中发现的沼泽木乃伊遗骸。1943年5月20日，一名泥炭工人发现了这具遗骸。头骨保存完好，但部分骨骼缺失，尤其是头骨与骨盆之间的许多骨骼。骨骼学鉴定认为死者是一名年轻女性。

en.t: Enactment of Martial law in Taiwan
en.s: Martial law in Taiwan (Chinese: 戒嚴時期; pinyin: Jièyán Shíqí; Pe̍h-ōe-jī: Kài-giâm sî-kî) refers to the periods in the history of Taiwan after World War II, during control by the Republic of China Armed Forces of the Kuomintang-led regime. The term is specifically used to refer to the over 38-year-long consecutive martial law period between 20 May 1949 and 14 July 1987, which was qualified as "the longest imposition of martial law by a regime anywhere in the world" at that time (having since been surpassed by Brunei).

zh.s: 台湾戒严时期指二战后由国民党领导的中华民国武装部队控制期间，台湾历史上实施戒严的时期。该词具体指1949年5月20日至1987年7月14日连续实施的戒严，时长超过38年。当时这被称为世界上一个政权实施时间最长的戒严令，后来这一纪录被文莱超过。

en.s: The championship play-off of the 1950–51 DDR-Oberliga took place on 20 May 1951 at the Ernst-Thälmann-Stadion in Chemnitz between Chemie Leipzig and Turbine Erfurt. The match decided the winner of the 1950–51 DDR-Oberliga, the 2nd season of the DDR-Oberliga, the top-level football league in East Germany. The match was necessary as both teams finished the season level on points.

en.s: The 1953 Urban Council Election was held on 20 May 1953 for the 4 elected seats of the Urban Council of Hong Kong. The elected seats extended from 2 seats to 4 seats in this election, which increased the total numbers of member from 13 to 15. For the first time the polling station was set in the Kowloon peninsula, at the Kowloon-Canton Railway Station in Tsim Sha Tsui, besides the one in Hong Kong Island. 2,536 of about 8,000 eligible voters cast ballots. All candidates elected were from the Reform Club, including Brook Bernacchi and Woo Pak-chuen.

en.s: The Battle of Sidi Semiane was a four-hour combat during the Algerian War of Independence which took place on 20 May 1957 in the Dahra mountains in Wilaya IV. The French army launched an attack on the mujahideen of the Algerian National Liberation Front in response to the Algerian victory in the battle of Sidi Mohand Aklouche on 26 April 1957. The battle lasted more than four hours.

zh.s: 西迪塞米安战役是阿尔及利亚独立战争期间的一场战斗，于1957年5月20日在第四军区的达赫拉山脉发生，持续4个多小时。作为对阿尔及利亚民族解放阵线武装于1957年4月26日赢得西迪穆罕德·阿克卢什战役的回应，法军发动了此次进攻。

en.s: On May 20, 1958, a Vickers Viscount airliner operating Capital Airlines Flight 300 was involved in a mid-air collision with a United States Air Force Lockheed T-33 jet trainer on a proficiency flight in the skies above Brunswick, Maryland. All 11 people on board the Viscount and one of the two crew in the T-33 were killed in the accident.

en.s: Pakistan International Airlines Flight 705 (PK705) was a Boeing 720 airliner that crashed while descending to land at Cairo International Airport on 20 May 1965. Of the 127 passengers and crew on board, all but 6 were killed. The crash was the deadliest aviation disaster to occur in Egypt at the time, and is now the third-deadliest. It is also the deadliest aviation disaster involving the Boeing 720.

zh.t: 巴基斯坦国际航空705号班机空难
zh.s: 巴基斯坦国际航空705号班机是一架波音720客机，于1965年5月20日下降准备在开罗国际机场降落时坠毁。机上127名乘客和机组人员中，除6人外全部遇难。这是当时埃及最严重的航空事故，如今死亡人数位列第三；也是波音720客机涉及的最严重空难。

en.s: The 1967 FA Cup final was the 86th final of the FA Cup. It took place on 20 May 1967 at Wembley Stadium and was contested between Tottenham Hotspur and Chelsea. It was the first FA Cup Final to be contested between two teams from London, and is thus often dubbed the "Cockney Cup Final". Tottenham won the match 2–1, their fifth triumph and third of the decade.

en.s: Chuknagar massacre (Bengali: চুকনগর গণহত্যা) was a massacre of Bengali Hindus committed by the Pakistan Army and local collaborators during the Bangladesh War of Independence in 1971. en.s: The 1980 Quebec referendum was the first referendum in Quebec on the place of Quebec within Canada and whether Quebec should pursue a path toward sovereignty. en.s: The 1990 Associate Members' Cup Final, known as the Leyland DAF Cup for sponsorship reasons, was the 7th final of the domestic football cup competition for teams from the Third Division and Fourth Division. en.s: The 1992 European Cup final was a football match held on 20 May 1992 at Wembley Stadium, London, between Barcelona of Spain and Sampdoria of Italy. Barcelona won the game 1–0 after extra time, thanks to a Ronald Koeman free kick, to record their first triumph in the competition. en.s: The French football bribery scandal (French: Affaire VA-OM) occurred during a 1992–93 French Division 1 match between Valenciennes and Olympique de Marseille. Marseille president Bernard Tapie and general manager Jean-Pierre Bernès contacted Valenciennes players Jorge Burruchaga, Jacques Glassmann, and Christophe Robert through Marseille player Jean-Jacques Eydelie, who asked them to underperform in the match so that Marseille could stay fresher for their 1993 UEFA Champions League final match against A.C.

zh.s: 法国足球贿赂丑闻（法语：Affaire VA-OM）发生于1992—93赛季法国甲级联赛瓦朗谢讷对阵马赛的比赛期间。马赛主席贝尔纳·塔皮和总经理让-皮埃尔·贝尔内斯通过马赛球员让-雅克·埃德利联系瓦朗谢讷球员豪尔赫·布鲁查加、雅克·格拉斯曼和克里斯托夫·罗贝尔，要求他们在比赛中放水，让马赛能为1993年欧冠决赛对阵AC做好体能准备。

en.s: The 1995 FA Cup final was a football match played at Wembley Stadium in London on 20 May 1995 to determine the winner of the 1994–95 FA Cup. The 50th FA Cup Final to be played at Wembley since the Second World War, it was contested by Everton and Manchester United. Everton won the match 1–0 via a headed goal by Paul Rideout, after Graham Stuart's shot rebounded off the crossbar.

en.s: The Supreme Court of the United States (SCOTUS) is the highest court in the federal judiciary of the United States. It has ultimate appellate jurisdiction over all U.S. federal court cases, and over state court cases that turn on questions of U.S. constitutional or federal law. It also has original jurisdiction over a narrow range of cases, specifically "all Cases affecting Ambassadors, other public Ministers and Consuls, and those in which a State shall be Party".

zh.s: 美国最高法院（SCOTUS）是美国联邦司法体系的最高法院，对所有联邦案件以及涉及美国宪法或联邦法律问题的州法院案件拥有最终上诉管辖权。它还对有限类别的案件拥有初审管辖权，具体包括涉及大使、其他外交使节和领事的案件，以及州作为当事方的案件。

en.s: The ninth Sarawak state election was held on Saturday, 20 May 2006 with nomination day on Tuesday, 9 May 2006. The election functioned to elect 71 representatives to the Sarawak State Assembly (Dewan Undangan Negeri in Malay). The eighth state assembly was dissolved by Yang di-Pertua Negeri Sarawak, Tun Abang Muhammad Salahuddin Abang Barieng by the advice of Chief Minister Abdul Taib Mahmud, on 24 April 2006. On nomination day, Barisan Nasional won two seats without contest. This election saw 892,537 voters eligible to cast their ballots. The previous state election was held in 2001, when the ruling Barisan Nasional (BN) won 60 out of 62 seats in the eighth state assembly.

zh.s: 第九届砂拉越州选举于2006年5月20日星期六举行，提名日为同年5月9日星期二，选出71名砂拉越州议会议员。第八届州议会于2006年4月24日解散，解散决定由砂拉越州元首敦阿邦穆罕默德·萨拉赫丁·阿邦·巴里恩在首席部长阿都泰益·马末建议下作出。提名日当天，国阵有两个席位因无人对垒而直接当选。本次选举共有892,537名合资格选民。上届选举于2001年举行，当时执政的国阵在62席中赢得60席。

en.s: Ma Ying-jeou (Chinese: 馬英九; pinyin: Mǎ Yīngjiǔ; Ma-ING-gee-oh; born 13 July 1950) is a Taiwanese politician, lawyer, and legal scholar who served as the sixth president of the Republic of China from 2008 to 2016. en.s: The 2009 UEFA Cup Final was the final match of the 2008–09 UEFA Cup, the 38th season of the UEFA Cup, UEFA's second-tier club football tournament. It was also the last final to be held under the UEFA Cup name, as the competition was rebranded as the UEFA Europa League from the 2009–10 season. The final was contested by Shakhtar Donetsk and Werder Bremen, with Shakhtar winning the match 2–1 after extra time. All three goalscorers in the game were Brazilians; lone striker Luiz Adriano opened the scoring for Shakhtar midway through the first half, before Naldo equalised from a free kick ten minutes later. The second half was goalless and the match went to extra time; after only seven minutes, Jádson scored for Shakhtar to secure the club's first major European trophy. The match was played at the Şükrü Saracoğlu Stadium – home ground of Fenerbahçe – in Istanbul, Turkey, on 20 May 2009.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the Dominican Republic on 20 May 2012. They were the fifth quadrennial elections for the presidency and vice-presidency since 1998, when a change in the electoral law separated the presidential from the congressional and municipal elections. As specified in the new constitution ratified in January 2010, the presidential elections of 2012 coincided with the election of Overseas Deputies in Dominican expatriate communities. Since 1974, elections in the Dominican Republic took place on 16 May every four years. Nevertheless, the constitutional reform of 2009 stipulated in article 209 that the elections would be held on 20 May 2012 to avoid their falling on a work day.

zh.s: 《NXT接管：芝加哥》是WWE于2017年5月20日星期六举办的职业摔角网络直播赛事，仅有来自WWE旗下培养品牌NXT的选手参加。这是第15届NXT接管赛事，也是首届以“芝加哥”为副标题的赛事。比赛在伊利诺伊州芝加哥郊区罗斯蒙特的奥尔斯泰特竞技场举行，是当年《反击》赛事周末的一部分，并独家通过WWE网络播出。

en.s: The 3rd Peoples' Democratic Party Extraordinary Congress was held on 20 May 2017 to elect a new female co-leader for the Turkish Peoples' Democratic Party (HDP). The party's previous chairwoman, Figen Yüksekdağ, had been imprisoned in November 2016 for inciting violence and distributing terrorist propaganda and had her party membership revoked on 9 March 2017. On 6 May 2017, the HDP Central Executive Committee met to appoint a new acting leader.

zh.t: 人民民主党第3届特别代表大会
zh.s: 土耳其人民民主党于2017年5月20日召开第3届特别代表大会，选出一名新的女性联合主席。该党前主席菲根·于克塞克达自2016年11月起因煽动暴力和散播恐怖主义宣传而被监禁，并于2017年3月9日被撤销党籍。2017年5月6日，人民民主党中央执行委员会开会任命代理领导人。

en.s: The 2017 Kuomintang chairmanship election (Chinese: 2017年中國國民黨主席選舉) was held on 20 May 2017. This was the eighth direct election of the party leader in Kuomintang history. All registered, due-paying KMT party members were eligible to vote.

zh.s: 2017年中国国民党主席选举于2017年5月20日举行。这是国民党历史上第8次直接选举党主席。所有完成登记并缴纳党费的党员均有投票资格。

en.s: The 2017 Cupa Ligii final was the final match of the 2016–17 Cupa Ligii, played between Dinamo București and Poli Timișoara. Dinamo București won the match with 2–0.

zh.s: 2017年罗马尼亚联赛杯决赛是2016—17赛季该项赛事的最后一场比赛，由布加勒斯特迪纳摩对阵蒂米什瓦拉波利。布加勒斯特迪纳摩以2比0获胜。

en.s: The 2017 Malaysia FA Cup final was the 28th final of the Malaysia FA Cup, the Malaysia football cup competition. Kedah won the cup after defeating Pahang 3–2 and were assured a place for the 2018 AFC Cup group stage.

zh.s: 2017年马来西亚足总杯决赛是该项赛事第28届决赛。吉打以3比2击败彭亨，夺得冠军，并获得参加2018年亚足联杯小组赛的资格。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Venezuela on 20 May 2018, with incumbent Nicolás Maduro being declared reelected for a second six-year term. The original electoral date was scheduled for December 2018 but was subsequently pulled ahead to 22 April before being pushed back to 20 May. Some analysts described the poll as a sham election, as many prominent opposition parties had been barred from participating in it.

zh.s: 委内瑞拉于2018年5月20日举行总统选举，时任总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗被宣布连任，开启第二个六年任期。选举原定于2018年12月举行，后来提前至4月22日，之后又改到5月20日。一些分析人士称这次选举是一场假选举，因为多个重要反对党被禁止参选。

en.s: The Rey del Ring (2018) show (Spanish for "King of the Ring") was a major annual lucha libre event produced and scripted by Mexican professional wrestling promotion International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG), and took place on May 20, 2018 in Arena Naucalpan, Naucalpan, State of Mexico, Mexico. The main event was the Eponymous IWRG Rey del Ring tournament, the sixteenth annual version of the tournament, IWRG's version of WWE's Royal Rumble, multi-man elimination event.

zh.s: 《擂台之王》（西班牙语意为“擂台之王”）是墨西哥职业摔角联盟IWRG制作并编排的年度大型赛事，于2018年5月20日在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘的瑙卡尔潘竞技场举行。主赛是第16届年度IWRG“擂台之王”锦标赛，形式类似WWE皇家大战，由多名选手参加淘汰赛。

en.s: The 2018 FA Trophy Final was a football match between Brackley Town and Bromley on 20 May 2018. It was the final match of the 2017–18 FA Trophy, the 49th season of the FA Trophy. Both teams were making their first appearances in the final.

zh.s: 2018年英格兰足总锦标赛决赛于5月20日举行，由布拉克利镇对阵布罗姆利，是2017—18赛季足总锦标赛的最后一场比赛，也是该赛事第49个赛季的决赛。两支球队都是首次闯入决赛。

en.s: The 2018 Taça de Portugal final was the last match of the 2017–18 Taça de Portugal, which decided the winner of the 78th season of the Taça de Portugal. It was played on 20 May 2018 at the Estádio Nacional in Oeiras, between Desportivo das Aves and Sporting CP. This was the first appearance for Desportivo das Aves in a Taça de Portugal final.

zh.s: 2018年葡萄牙杯决赛是2017—18赛季葡萄牙杯的最后一场比赛，决出该项赛事第78个赛季的冠军。比赛于2018年5月20日在奥埃拉什国家体育场举行，由阿维斯体育对阵里斯本竞技。这是阿维斯体育首次闯入葡萄牙杯决赛。

en.s: The 2018 FA Vase final was the 44th final of the Football Association's cup competition for teams at levels 9–11 of the English football league system. The match was contested between Stockton Town, of the Northern League Division One, and Thatcham Town, of the Hellenic League Premier Division. This was the first time both teams had reached the final and the first visit to Wembley Stadium for both sides.

zh.s: 2018年英格兰足总花瓶杯决赛是英格兰足总杯赛的第44届决赛，参赛球队来自英格兰足球联赛系统第9至第11级。对阵双方是北部联赛甲级的斯托克顿镇和希腊联赛超级组的塔查姆镇。两队都是首次闯入决赛，也都是首次到温布利球场比赛。

en.s: General elections were held in Burundi on 20 May 2020 to elect both the president and the National Assembly. Évariste Ndayishimiye of the ruling CNDD–FDD was elected president with 71% of the vote. In the National Assembly elections, the CNDD–FDD won 72 of the 100 elected seats.

zh.s: 布隆迪于2020年5月20日举行大选，选出总统和国民议会议员。执政党保卫民主力量—保卫民主全国委员会（CNDD–FDD）候选人埃瓦里斯特·恩达伊施米耶以71%的得票率当选总统。国民议会选举中，该党在100个民选席位中赢得72席。

en.s: The 2022 CAF Confederation Cup final was the final match of the 2021–22 CAF Confederation Cup, the 19th season of Africa's premier club football tournament organised by CAF under the current CAF Confederation Cup title after the merger of CAF Cup and African Cup Winners' Cup. It was played at the Godswill Akpabio International Stadium in Uyo, Nigeria on 20 May 2022.

zh.s: 2022年非洲足联联合会杯决赛是2021—22赛季该项赛事的最后一场比赛，也是非洲顶级俱乐部足球赛事的第19个赛季；该项赛事由非洲足联主办，沿用现名之前由非洲足联杯和非洲优胜者杯合并而成。比赛于2022年5月20日在尼日利亚乌约的戈德斯威尔·阿克帕比奥国际体育场举行。

en.t: Russo-Ukrainian war: Russia claims full control of the Ukrainian city of Mariupol after a nearly three-month siege
en.s: The Russo-Ukrainian war began in February 2014 and is ongoing. Following Ukraine's Revolution of Dignity, Russia occupied Crimea and annexed it from Ukraine. It then supported Russian separatist armed groups who started a war in the eastern Donbas region against Ukraine's military. In 2018, Ukraine declared the region to be occupied by Russia. The first eight years of conflict also involved naval incidents and cyberwarfare.

zh.t: 俄乌战争：俄罗斯称在近三个月围城后已完全控制乌克兰城市马里乌波尔
zh.s: 俄乌战争始于2014年2月，至今仍在持续。乌克兰尊严革命后，俄罗斯占领克里米亚并将其并入俄罗斯。随后，俄罗斯支持亲俄武装团体在顿巴斯东部地区与乌克兰军队交战。2018年，乌克兰宣布该地区遭俄罗斯占领。冲突头八年还涉及海上事件和网络战。

en.t: Russo-Ukrainian war: Russia claimed full control of Mariupol after a nearly three-month siege
en.s: The siege of Mariupol began on 24 February 2022, as part of the Russian invasion of Ukraine, and lasted until 20 May. It saw fighting between the Russian Armed Forces (alongside the Donetsk People's Republic People's Militia) and the Ukrainian Armed Forces for control over the city of Mariupol in southeastern Ukraine.

zh.t: 俄乌战争：俄罗斯在近三个月围城后宣称完全控制马里乌波尔
zh.s: 马里乌波尔围城于2022年2月24日开始，是俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的一部分，持续至5月20日。战斗双方是俄罗斯武装部队（与顿涅茨克人民共和国民兵并肩作战）和乌克兰武装部队，争夺乌克兰东南部城市马里乌波尔的控制权。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Dern vs. Hill
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Dern vs. Hill (also known as UFC Fight Night 223, UFC Vegas 73, and UFC on ESPN+ 81) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on May 20, 2023, at the UFC Apex facility in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Metropolitan Area, United States.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：德恩对阵希尔
zh.s: UFC格斗之夜：德恩对阵希尔也称UFC格斗之夜223、UFC拉斯维加斯73或UFC ESPN+ 81，是终极格斗冠军赛主办的一场综合格斗赛事，于2023年5月20日在美国内华达州恩特普赖斯的UFC巅峰训练中心举行。恩特普赖斯属于拉斯维加斯都会区。

en.s: The 2023 Thai League Cup final was the final match of the 2022–23 Thai League Cup, the 13th season in the second era of a Thailand's football tournament organized by Football Association of Thailand. It was played at the Thunderdome Stadium in Nonthaburi, Thailand on 20 May 2023, between Buriram United a big team from Buriram that located in the Northeastern part and BG Pathum United a big team from Pathum Thani that located in the Bangkok Metropolitan Region of Thailand.

zh.s: 2023年泰国联赛杯决赛是2022—23赛季泰国联赛杯的最后一场比赛，也是该项足球赛事第二阶段的第13个赛季，由泰国足球协会主办。比赛于2023年5月20日在泰国暖武里府雷霆巨蛋体育场举行，由武里南联对阵巴吞联。武里南联是来自泰国东北部武里南府的强队，巴吞联则来自曼谷都会区内的巴吞他尼府。

en.s: The 2022 Norwegian Football Cup final was the final match of the 2022 Norwegian Football Cup, the 116th season of the Norwegian Football Cup, the premier Norwegian football cup competition organized by the Football Association of Norway (NFF). The match was played on 20 May 2023 at the Ullevaal Stadion in Oslo, between Eliteserien teams Brann and Lillestrøm.

zh.s: 2022年挪威足球杯决赛是该届杯赛的最后一场比赛，也是挪威足协（NFF）举办的第116届挪威足球杯赛事的决赛。比赛于2023年5月20日在奥斯陆乌勒瓦尔球场举行，由挪超球队布兰和利勒斯特伦对阵。

en.s: The 2023 European Rugby Champions Cup Final was the final match of the 2022–23 European Rugby Champions Cup, and the twenty-eighth European club rugby final in general. The final was contested by Leinster and La Rochelle, and a repeat of the 2022 Final which La Rochelle won 24–21. The Aviva Stadium was the host venue of the final, just the second time it has hosted the game having also been the venue in 2013.

zh.s: 2023年欧洲橄榄球冠军杯决赛是2022—23赛季该项赛事的最后一场比赛，也是欧洲俱乐部橄榄球赛事的第28届总决赛。对阵双方是伦斯特和拉罗谢尔，重演了2022年决赛；当时拉罗谢尔以24比21获胜。阿维瓦体育场承办本届决赛，这是该场地第二次举办这项赛事，此前一次是在2013年。

en.s: The 2024 Indian general election was held in Ladakh on 20 May 2024 to elect 1 member of the 18th Lok Sabha. These elections are the first elections to be held in Ladakh after the separating of the territory from Jammu and Kashmir under the Jammu and Kashmir Reorganisation Act, 2019 and granting it a separate Union territory status.

zh.s: 印度于2024年5月20日在拉达克举行大选，选出第18届人民院的一名议员。这是拉达克在2019年《查谟和克什米尔重组法》将该地区与查谟和克什米尔分开、并赋予其独立联邦属地地位后举行的首次选举。

en.t: 2025 New York Senate District 22 special election
en.s: A special election in the U.S. state of New York was held on May 20, 2025, to elect a new member for the 22nd district in the New York Senate, representing a portion of Kings County, which is coextensive with the borough of Brooklyn. The election filled a vacancy caused by the resignation of Democratic state senator Simcha Felder upon his election to the New York City Council.

zh.t: 2025年纽约州参议院第22选区特别选举
zh.s: 美国纽约州于2025年5月20日举行特别选举，选出州参议院第22选区的新议员。该选区涵盖金斯县一部分，与布鲁克林区范围相同。选举是为填补空缺而举行；民主党州参议员辛查·费尔德当选纽约市议会议员后辞职。

en.t: NASCAR Hall of Fame Class of 2026 ballot
en.s: Three new members were voted in to the NASCAR Hall of Fame on May 20, 2025, from a list of nominees provided by NASCAR. The nominees are split into two categories, the Modern Era, and the Pioneer Era. The final decision was made by the NASCAR Hall of Fame voting panel, who will also decide the winner of the Landmark Award.

zh.s: 2025年5月20日，NASCAR从其公布的候选名单中选出3名新成员，纳入NASCAR名人堂。候选人分为现代组和先锋组。最终人选由名人堂评审团决定，评审团还将选出“地标奖”得主。

en.s: The 2026 UEFA Europa League final was the final match of the 2025–26 UEFA Europa League, the 55th season of Europe's secondary club football tournament organised by UEFA, and the 17th season since it was renamed from the UEFA Cup to the UEFA Europa League. It was played at Beşiktaş Stadium in Istanbul, Turkey, on 20 May 2026 between German club SC Freiburg and English club Aston Villa.

zh.s: 2026年欧洲联赛决赛是2025—26赛季欧洲联赛的最后一场比赛，也是该项欧洲俱乐部次级赛事的第55个赛季、第17个以“欧洲联赛”为名的赛季。比赛于2026年5月20日在土耳其伊斯坦布尔的贝西克塔什公园球场举行，由德国弗赖堡对阵英格兰阿斯顿维拉。
